metadata.title: Define Bronze and Silver Layer Structure

story.iWant: to define the bronze and silver layer directory structure and naming conventions
story.soThat: we have a clear foundation for organizing assets by data maturity level
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create Bronze Layer Directory Structure (AC: 1) - Create artifacts/bronze/ directory - Create artifacts/bronze/raw_links/ subdirectory - Create artifacts/bronze/raw_html/ subdirectory - Verify directories exist with correct permissions - Task 2: Create Silver Layer Directory Structure (AC: 2) - Create artifacts/silver/ directory - Create artifacts/silver/extracted_content/ subdirectory - Create artifacts/silver/summaries/ subdirectory - Verify directories exist with correct permissions - Task 3: Document Medallion Architecture in Architecture Doc (AC: 3) - Add "Medallion Architecture" section to docs/architecture.md - Document bronze layer responsibilities (raw, immutable data) - Document silver layer responsibilities (processed, application-ready data) - Document data flow: bronze → silver - Document full SHA256 hash usage (replacing [:16] truncation) - Document timestamp requirements (created_at, updated_at) - Task 4: Update Development Guide with New Structure (AC: 3) - Update project structure diagram in docs/development-guide.md - Add medallion layer directories to structure - Note coexistence with current flat structure during migration - Task 5: Document Asset Naming Convention (AC: 4) - Create naming convention section in docs/architecture.md - Document pattern: {layer}_{data_type} (e.g., bronze_raw_links) - Provide examples for all planned assets - Document file naming within directories (full SHA256 hash) - Task 6: Integration Test for Directory Structure (AC: 1, 2) - Create test file: tests/integration/test_medallion_structure.py - Test verifies bronze directories exist - Test verifies silver directories exist - Test verifies directory permissions are correct - Mark with @pytest.mark.integration

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Bronze layer directory created at artifacts/bronze/ with subdirectories for raw_links/ and raw_html/
Silver layer directory created at artifacts/silver/ with subdirectories for extracted_content/ and summaries/
Layer structure documented in development guide or architecture docs
Asset naming convention established (e.g., bronze_raw_links, silver_extracted_content)

doc.title: Technical Specification - Epic 1: Medallion Architecture Migration
doc.snippet: Defines bronze layer (artifacts/bronze/raw_links/, artifacts/bronze/raw_html/) for raw data and silver layer (artifacts/silver/extracted_content/, artifacts/silver/summaries/) for processed data. Full SHA256 hashes replace truncated [:16] hashes.

doc.title: Technical Specification - Epic 1: Medallion Architecture Migration
doc.snippet: Asset naming follows pattern: {layer}_{data_type} (e.g., bronze_raw_links, silver_extracted_content). File naming uses full SHA256(url).{extension} format.

doc.title: Technical Specification - Epic 1: Medallion Architecture Migration
doc.snippet: AC002: All artifacts include created_at (ISO 8601). AC003: Silver artifacts include updated_at and lineage metadata (source_asset, source_hash, transformation_timestamp).

doc.title: Epic Breakdown - Story 1.1
doc.section: Story 1.1: Define Bronze and Silver Layer Structure
doc.snippet: Bronze layer: artifacts/bronze/ with raw_links/ and raw_html/. Silver layer: artifacts/silver/ with extracted_content/ and summaries/. Document structure in development guide or architecture docs.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR001: Bronze Layer for Raw Data
doc.snippet: Bronze layer stores raw, immutable data (links and HTML) enabling reprocessing without re-downloading. Uses full SHA256 hashes for collision-free filenames.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR002: Silver Layer for Processed Data
doc.snippet: Silver layer stores processed, application-ready data (extracted content and summaries) with full metadata including timestamps and lineage tracking.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Current storage uses artifacts/html/, artifacts/videos/, artifacts/summaries/ with SHA256[:16] hash filenames. Medallion migration will introduce layered structure with full hashes.

doc.title: Data Models and Storage
doc.snippet: Current structure: artifacts/{html,videos,summaries}/{hash}.json using SHA256(url)[:16]. File naming convention and deduplication logic via file existence checks.

doc.title: Development Guide
doc.snippet: Project structure includes artifacts/ directory for pipeline outputs. Tests located in tests/ with integration/ subdirectory. Pytest configuration in pyproject.toml.

file.reason: Example of integration test pattern using pytest fixtures and tmp_path for directory creation testing
Existing integration test structure to follow for test_medallion_structure.py

constraints.constraint: Directory creation only - no code migration in this story
Existing artifacts/html/, artifacts/videos/, artifacts/summaries/ remain unchanged
Migration to new structure happens in Stories 1.4-1.7
Documentation must be updated in docs/architecture.md and docs/development-guide.md
Integration test required, unit tests optional per tech spec
Full SHA256 hashes (64 chars) replace current truncated [:16] hashes
All artifacts must include created_at timestamp (ISO 8601)
Silver artifacts must include updated_at and lineage metadata
Use pytest.mark.integration marker for integration tests

tests.standards: Testing framework: pytest (>=8.4.2) with markers for unit, integration, and contract tests. Test organization: tests/ directory with integration/ subdirectory. Integration tests use @pytest.mark.integration marker. Test patterns: Use pytest fixtures (tmp_path for temporary directories), factory-boy for test data generation. Quality gates: make check runs format, lint, typecheck, and tests. Integration tests required for this story per tech spec. Configuration: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] defines test paths, markers, and options (-v --strict-markers).
tests.locations: tests/integration/ - Integration tests (required for this story) tests/ - Unit tests (optional for this story) tests/fixtures/ - Test fixtures and data

ideas.idea: Test: test_medallion_directory_structure_exists Approach: Verify artifacts/bronze/{raw_links,raw_html}/ and artifacts/silver/{extracted_content,summaries}/ exist Pattern: Use pathlib.Path.exists() assertions, similar to e2e_test_env fixture pattern
Test: test_directory_permissions Approach: Verify created directories have correct read/write permissions Pattern: Use Path.stat().st_mode to check permissions

Test: test_directory_structure_isolation Approach: Verify new directories don't interfere with existing artifacts/{html,videos,summaries}/ Pattern: Check old structure still exists alongside new structure

Test: test_documentation_updated Approach: Verify docs/architecture.md and docs/development-guide.md contain medallion architecture sections Pattern: Read files and assert presence of specific sections/keywords

Test: test_naming_convention_documented Approach: Verify docs/architecture.md contains asset naming examples (bronze_raw_links, silver_extracted_content) Pattern: Parse documentation and verify examples present
